user_query: I'm planning a surprise birthday party for my friend next month. Can you suggest some fun activities and games that we can organize? Also, recommend some popular songs to create a party playlist. Additionally, find a nearby restaurant that can accommodate a group of 20 people for dinner after the party.

TaskList.description: Research fun activities and games suitable for a birthday party.
Generate a playlist of popular songs for the party.
Find nearby restaurants that can accommodate a group of 20 people.
